{{Quote|At any rate, the Council's hardly going to send him out to Marcol sector when there are so many pressing matters to be attended to here.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Jorus C'baoth]]|<ref name="OF" />}}
The '''Marcol sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]].

==History==
[[Jorus C'baoth]], [[Lorana Jinzler]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled to the sector in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] to resolve a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] dispute on Barlok.<ref name="OF" />
